messages.subject: bug? error when plotting facte_grid(margins=TRUE, labeller=YN_labeller)
parts:
I have a custom labeller that recodes logical() as character()['N','Y'] defined as

YN_labeller<-function(var,val) if(is.logical(val)) {ifelse(val,'Y','N')} else label_value(var,val)

It works fine to relabel all my logicals as 'Y' 'N'.

However, when I ALSO pass `margins=TRUE` I get error:  invalid to change the storage mode of a factor                                                                                                                                  

All workarounds happily received, especially if the accomplish the same effect by different means.

Cheers

I don't see the error you are seeing. Here is a reproducible example:

library("ggplot2")

mtc <- transform(mtcars, lowcarb = carb < 3.5)

p <- ggplot(mtc, aes(wt, mpg)) + geom_point()

YN_labeller <- function(var,val) {

p + facet_grid(~lowcarb)
p + facet_grid(~lowcarb, labeller=YN_labeller)
p + facet_grid(~lowcarb, labeller=YN_labeller, margins=TRUE)

All three plots at the end plot and non give an error. The last one does
not convert FALSE and TRUE to N and Y, but it doesn't give an error. To
understand why no conversion is done for the last one with margins, it
helps to add a `str(var)` and `str(val)` to the beginning of
`YN_labeller`. With that addition you get, for the last two plots:

> p + facet_grid(~lowcarb, labeller=YN_labeller)
chr "lowcarb"
logi [1:2] FALSE TRUE
> p + facet_grid(~lowcarb, labeller=YN_labeller, margins=TRUE)
chr "lowcarb"
Factor w/ 3 levels "FALSE","TRUE",..: 1 2 3

You see, when there is a margin, the values (`val`) have been promoted
to a character and then factor, with "(all)" added as a possible level.
So the `val`'s aren't logical anymore (which they could not be since
there is an "(all)" option).

Here is a version of `YN_labeller` which (also) doesn't throw an error
and does convert the TRUE/FALSE into Y/N even when there is a margin:

YN_labeller <- function(var,val) {

} else {
label <- label_value(var,val)
label[label=="FALSE"] <- "N"
label[label=="TRUE"] <- "Y"
label
}
}
